producer-propagation.contract: Encoder append -> deferred finish -> queue submission -> application continuation -> map callback/readback/product. Recording Result is not a finish verdict.
producer-propagation.disposition: R1 actionable in Batch and standalone pass; Reduce manual record is a required consumer. All 115 locations/104 enclosing functions are individually classified in caller-code-review JSON. Existing Result production consumers must short-circuit before reads/publication. Armor/metal E1 cannot stringify causes; retained774 handover required. Direct context-backed texture submissions also have deferred errors; proposed same helper receiving subset is awaiting exact780 agreement. Raw renderer/Bevy ports and marker are explicitly separate, not silently certified.
producer-propagation.repair: One WgpuContext submit owner; actual SDK error -> existing ComputePassError::Native -> existing anyhow/Hair Backend/canonical agreed armor owner. 780 migrates all producers, callers and fixtures; retained774 contracts remain required.
producer-propagation.acceptance: No ignored Result, formatted cause or failed predecessor followed by dependent read/success publication; exact owner source lineage integrated.

existing-type-owners.contract: Native wgpu::Error and SubmissionIndex already own provider outcomes; ComputePassError::Native owns pass causes; canonical BufferByteOffset/Length and WorkgroupGrid own byte/launch values.
existing-type-owners.disposition: No SubmissionError, fake native error, new provider identifier, replacement byte/launch type or second copy/submit backend needed. Hair Backend already accepts anyhow; armor Arc<str> and metal String are explicit E1 owner gaps. GPU native Cargo feature std is the SDK-owned thread-id contract, not a new application mutex/identity type.
existing-type-owners.repair: Reuse canonical SDK/concrete error owners and lower GPU context; consume780 canonical count/layout types without duplicating them.
existing-type-owners.acceptance: One declaration per concept, primitive extraction only at native boundary, supported SDK Error trait bounds preserved.

admission-contracts.contract: Native context observation requires encoder/device/queue provenance, cfg(native), blocking_validation and the Validation filter. Borrowed/browser paths are device-handled; native feature std supplies per-thread scope keys.
admission-contracts.disposition: R1 recording admission is incomplete native admission. Public raw CommandEncoder cannot prove foreign-device provenance; Batch/pass create their own encoder and preserve that lineage. Existing view cache-first/missing/uninitialized/wrong-device contracts remain unchanged. Native std must be explicit because cfg(std) alias does not enable cfg(feature=std) ThreadId implementation.
admission-contracts.repair: Native-only GPU wgpu feature std; focused helper scopes finish/pop before queue and queue/pop separately. No guard across await/callback/batch lifetime and no GPU-completion Wait. Preserve source constructor/device policy; do not synthesize fake context for external ports.
admission-contracts.acceptance: Known rejected command buffer never submitted; actual captured failure returned; supported feature/provenance/filter limits documented without blanket native guarantees.

invariant-operations.contract: Fallible finish consumes encoder; callbacks run once in order only after helper Ok. Recorded count counts appended work. Checked copy ends and unchanged uniform packing remain host preconditions.
invariant-operations.disposition: M1 required: sim head/shaped/clock/collision selectors, BVH layout and hash recorded build mutate before finish. Some metadata supports same-batch consumers; blindly moving or rolling it back breaks those contracts. Stereo/history/product publication after submit can be gated with Result. Earlier successful substeps remain committed; whole-frame rollback is not promised.
invariant-operations.repair: 780 defines safe failed-submit reuse/discard/invalidity while retaining recorded metadata meaning; root callback gating; no fake transactional or GPU-completion promise.
invariant-operations.acceptance: Failed submission cannot leave metadata silently reused as materialized content; dependent CPU projection/stages stop; original partial-progress scheduling preserved.

aggregate-states.contract: Context device/queue/encoder form one provider relationship; batch owns encoder/uniform resources/callbacks; pending mapping requires successful host submission before mapping readiness.
aggregate-states.disposition: Independent valid fields do not establish provider membership or submitted content. PendingReadback has Pending/Ready/Failed/Taken but no submit-failed transition; callback drop on Err leaves a held handle Pending, requiring documented discard and caller propagation. Texture allocation/cache/format/device combinations and selected effective format remain governed by previous exact source evidence.
aggregate-states.repair: Keep actual provider lineage, consume batch on submission, drop application callbacks on Err;780 caller/readback docs require discard after failed submit. Resolve external renderer provider policy and retained774 associations explicitly.
aggregate-states.acceptance: No invented automatic cancellation, false Ready, fake context or cached/submitted authority confusion.

type-ownership.contract: GPU globals own WgpuContext native submission; compute Batch owns callback lifecycle; existing pass error owns typed adapter;780 owns count/layout/producers and caches;774 retains exact non-core functions.
type-ownership.disposition: Agreed context helper avoids a ComputePass submit wrapper/duplicate policy. Current exact archives versus current human/core agreement are recorded per function in rule-review JSON. Whole-function retained claims include Buffer::read, grow, armor, metal, fitting and fixtures; no path-neighbor claim is fabricated as an exact match.
type-ownership.repair: Root edits only agreed core/helper/docs/feature subset; proposed context texture subset requires agreement before change.780 performs coordinated caller graph;774 receiving/error handover remains required.
type-ownership.acceptance: One exact combined source lineage, no competing claimed whole-function repair, and no incomplete path relabeled follow-up.

redundant-authority.contract: Actual captured SDK outcome is authoritative for observed finish/submission; successful recording/cache compilation is a different fact from accepted commands or GPU completion.
redundant-authority.disposition: Current infallible submit index/callback can disagree with actual error after returning uncaptured handler. Recorder scopes cannot serve as finalization authority. Cached pipeline success is not invalidated merely by bad external dispatch; recorded_layout/HashBuild cannot imply execution.
redundant-authority.repair: One context submission outcome consumed by Batch/pass/all context-backed receiving paths; retain earlier immediate construction scopes and converter error priority. No duplicate submitted flag/global device branding/parallel unchecked API.
redundant-authority.acceptance: Callbacks and success publication derive from returned submission Result; docs separate recorded, validated, submitted, mapped and completed facts.

behavior-preservation.contract: Preserve command order, empty-first Batch behavior, cache-first texture precedence, effective format, uniform provided-value protocol, explicit readback/completion waits and phase scheduling.
behavior-preservation.disposition: Intentional change is observed deferred rejection becomes Err before continuations. Zero-byte logically valid same-buffer copy still receives native checks at finish. Device-handled paths keep uncaptured-handler policy and cannot claim observed acceptance. Converter already scopes creation/finish/submit and must not lose earliest error. Raw completion marker is unaffected. Existing fixture inputs/oracles/population remain fixed.
behavior-preservation.repair: Gate only dependent success continuation; no additional GPU-completion Wait, blanket rollback, cache eviction or new tests. Existing tests receive API/error adaptation only by owner.
behavior-preservation.acceptance: Source comparison plus required hosted existing checks at final SHA; no hardware/browser/performance claims from source review.

enum-shapes.contract: Result owns submitted index or concrete failure; existing Native variant owns SDK error; pending readback variants own mapping lifecycle; texture absence and rejection remain distinct.
enum-shapes.disposition: No extra success bool beside Result or synthetic Cancelled/Failed state without implementing lifecycle. Validation policy bool remains established context predicate with target cfg; adding another observed flag to every submit would duplicate existing policy. Hair/BVH/hash recorded state needs owner-defined safe reuse contract, not a new root competing state enum.
enum-shapes.repair: Use Result and existing error/pending states. Keep native/device-handled limits explicit;780 addresses M1/E1 canonical states.
enum-shapes.acceptance: No impossible success/error payload combinations, silently pending lifecycle promise, or duplicate submitted/error flags.

derivability.contract: Native SDK errors retain source semantics; context remains Clone with Arc ports; callbacks FnOnce and encoder are consumed, not cloned/serialized.
derivability.disposition: No new trait boilerplate required for helper or Batch return. Existing Error/Display manual implementations retain specific native and conversion source branches; derive substitutions are not justified by this delta. SDK Error Send/Sync uses cfg(send_sync); native and fragile non-atomic Wasm evidence does not prove browser atomics. No unsafe trait workaround.
derivability.repair: Return SDK error directly and wrap Arc once at existing pass owner; keep existing Clone/source contracts and supported target cfg.
derivability.acceptance: No erased source or artificially asserted Send/Sync; final hosted target gates establish compile bounds.

type-granularity.contract: Native submission index, recorded dispatch count, invocation/item/group counts, byte offsets/lengths and GPU completion have distinct meanings.
type-granularity.disposition: Result<SubmissionIndex,wgpuError> is sufficient focused boundary; no general runtime submission service, all-purpose failure type or one-value wrappers needed. Byte-copy record carries two semantically distinct offsets plus length. Raw providers lacking context remain a real architectural receiving-policy dependency, not a reason to invent fake instance/adapter fields.
type-granularity.repair: One focused context submission module; preserve canonical count/layout/byte distinctions and lower-layer ownership.
type-granularity.acceptance: No primitive roundtrip migration or redundant wrapper, no conflation of host acceptance and GPU completion.

magic-strings.contract: Strings at labels/WGSL/diagnostic output are native or presentation boundaries; internal decisions use typed errors/state.
magic-strings.disposition: R1 fix adds no message classification or string protocol. Armor device_error and metal String remain E1 source-erasure defects; review enumerates exact claimed functions. Cargo feature std is the SDK feature token, not an application semantic value. Existing entry-point cache String is full identity, not message-derived authority.
magic-strings.repair: Preserve concrete causes through canonical owners, format only UI/log boundary. Docs describe available Validation errors, no textual matching or reconstructed native-looking message.
magic-strings.acceptance: No new internal tostring/Debug cause conversion or string branching; retained E1 family resolved before final clearance.

magic-numbers.contract: Native Validation filter is an SDK enum; submission helper introduces no timeouts, poll intervals, queue-drain counts, synthetic IDs, numeric statuses or tuning constants.
magic-numbers.disposition: Prior exact canonical byte/launch/uniform evidence remains applicable. Caller fixture literals remain existing fixtures; native copy/texture descriptors are explicit SDK adapters. No new wait milliseconds or dummy empty encoder for completion marker is needed. Native std is a feature change, no new backend capability/limit values.
magic-numbers.repair: Preserve checked byte ends and native boundary extraction, no GPU Wait or new raw policy constant.780 retains canonical workgroup/count/layout/stride operations and F19 extraction dependencies.
magic-numbers.acceptance: No duplicated semantic owner or raw internal unit propagation; same final hosted gates and source-audit waves required.
